system.description:
Required Weapon: Rapier A Montaigne style focused on humiliation and psychological domination. Its masters circle and mock, grinding down opponents until they make mistakes.

  • Valroux Cross. When you avoid marking HP from an enemy, you may mark any number of Stress to increase your Evasion and reduce your opponent’s Difficulty for the rest of the scene by that amount.
  • Opportune Strike. When you deal damage to a Vulnerable or Restrained target, they must also mark a Stress.
  • Feed on the Fumes. Spend 2 Hope to recover a Stress.
